symbols.name: AuditFilterSnapshot
symbols.summary: Copies filter input without retaining mutable caller objects or invoking object serialization.

symbols.name: Copy(FilterModel, int, int)
symbols.summary: Creates an independent, bounded copy, preserving null input and null members.
symbols.remarks: Values accept immutable audit scalars, JSON, one-dimensional scalar or object arrays, standard string-keyed dictionaries, and filter criteria. Dictionaries in values become ordinal string/object dictionaries. Total text and scalar value data is limited to 64 KiB, collections to 1024 items, and the copied graph to 4096 nodes.

syntax.content: public static FilterModel Copy(FilterModel source, int maxCriteria = 32, int maxDepth = 8)

parameters.description: The model to copy, or null.
The combined criterion and specification-node limit, between 1 and 1024.
The maximum nested criterion, specification, or value depth, between 1 and 64.

returns.description: A deep copy, or null when the source is null.
